recordText: From the early 1300s, first of things ("wicked, sinful"), later of people. Latin *malignus*: *male*, badly, + *-gnus*, born.
gossipText: The evil twin, born the same decade, by the same route, from the same root. Was simply born badly, and has made a whole personality of it.
testimony: Origin: unknown. That's what the record says about him. Unknown! At a family reunion! I'm only saying what everyone's thinking.
